## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in London, United Kingdom. It starts at Cutty Sark, King William Walk, Greenwich SE10 9HT. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Step aboard the legendary Cutty Sark, the world’s last surviving tea clipper, with your entry ticket to this iconic Greenwich attraction. Built in 1869, the Cutty Sark was one of the fastest ships of her time, racing across the oceans to deliver tea and other goods from China to Britain. Now beautifully restored, this historic ship offers a unique glimpse into the golden age of sailing.
>
> Explore the ship’s decks and marvel at its sleek design, which helped it achieve record-breaking speeds. Step into the captain’s quarters and crew’s living spaces to see what life was like aboard during long voyages at sea. Don’t miss the chance to walk beneath the ship’s towering hull, raised high for visitors to admire, and learn about the innovative engineering that made it a marvel of its time.
>
> Interactive exhibits and hands-on displays bring the ship’s history to life, making it an engaging experience for visitors of all ages. With breathtaking views of the River Thames and London’s skyline, the Cutty Sark is more than a museum—it’s a journey back in time.
>
> Book your ticket today and set sail on an unforgettable adventure aboard one of Britain’s greatest maritime treasures!
